sentence_stem: The director told the journalists that
correct_completion: the film would be released in May.
full_sentence: The director told the journalists that the film would be released in May.
acceptable_variants: the film was going to be released in May.
the release of the film was set for May.

options.text: the film will be released in May.
options.why_wrong: After a past reporting verb such as 'told', the future 'will' normally shifts back to 'would' in reported speech.

options.text: the film would be released in May.
would the film be released in May?
options.why_wrong: A reported question needs statement word order and no question mark; a reported statement cannot keep the question form.
This clause has no finite verb, so it cannot complete the reported statement introduced by 'that'.

grammar_focus: Backshift of tenses in reported speech after a past reporting verb
explanation: When the reporting verb is in the past, the verb in the reported clause usually moves one step back in time, so the future form becomes a conditional form. Portuguese speakers may transfer the future tense directly, because their first language does not always apply this shift in the same way.
translation: O diretor disse aos jornalistas que o filme seria lançado em maio.
